messages:
carmen: Heads-up: we've got priority-queue starvation in us-west beginning ~16:12 UTC. Dedicated customers on reserved pools are seeing elevated tail latency and sporadic 429/504s. Opening thread and paging infra. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/2987654321

ops-bot: Alert: priority-queue-starvation.us-west (alert_id=pq-usw-29876)

oncall-sre: Investigating now. Initial read: scheduler change rolled out last night reduced per-worker high-priority queue depth from 256->64. Under bursty commit patterns this exhausts accept queues and drops requests. Collecting scheduler logs and per-pool stats.

arun: Can we bump PQ depth back as an immediate mitigation? I'll push a conservative override to 192 for us-west reserved pools. Command: `helm upgrade infra-scheduler --set pqDepth=192 --namespace infra`

lena: Override applied at 16:18 UTC. Expect client-facing improvements within the next reconciliation cycle (~30s). Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.in/d/scheduler/us-west-queues

jamie: Notifying affected account managers for top impacted Dedicated customers (anonymized): D-CUST-502, D-CUST-611. Also drafting a short comms note for status page.

oncall-sre: After override, 429s dropped from 1.9% -> 0.12% by 16:22. Tail p95 latency improved but still ~15% elevated vs baseline. Looks like some workers hit accept-queue thrash; I'm restarting router pods on reserved pools one at a time to drain backlog. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/reserved-router -n dedicated --max-unavailable=1`

ops-bot: Metric update: scheduler.high_priority_drop_rate.us-west 16:15: 1.9% -> 16:25: 0.08%

arun: Rolling back the scheduler patch that introduced the PQ depth change in staging now. If staging stable for 20m we'll cut a proper hotfix to u-west and global reserved pools.

lena: Customer bulletin drafted: "We observed intermittent elevated tail latency and rate-limited requests for Dedicated pools in us-west between 16:12-16:20 UTC due to a scheduler config regression. We applied a temporary override and are rolling a hotfix. Account teams notified." Posting to status page.

oncall-sre: Hotfix v2.7.1 (reverts pq-depth regression) promoted to us-west at 16:40 UTC with controlled restarts. Observability shows queues behaving normally.

ops-bot: Incident metadata: severity=sev2, impacted_region=us-west, product=dedicated, customer_impact=partial, start_ts=2987654321

carmen: Current status: mitigated (temporary override + hotfix rolled). ETA for full verification and postmortem: 4 hours. Postmortem owner: arun. Runbook + logs: https://wiki.redwood.com/dedicated/pq-starvation-runbook

oncall-sre: Will monitor for 60 minutes before marking resolved. If anyone sees regressions, ping the pager or reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
